answer: Sealed-storage race: each fake identity costs about 2 TB of unique disk, roughly $30 a month. Every agent keeps its own ocean of data encoded to its address; each epoch an inlet challenge asks for 64 random chunks that must return within 2 seconds, or the identity slides off the ledge of standing. A farm cannot share one disk, since each copy is encoded per address, and rebuilding one on demand takes hours, so the deadline fails.
